comment: design-scout source registry (WSF-09). A new source is a row here, not code. enabled=false requires disabled_reason. License policies per CONTRACT.md §4 (OD-2 owner 2026-07-14).

sources.name: openverse
sources.robots_note: public API, no key for anonymous tier; UA header REQUIRED — default urllib UA gets 403; anonymous page_size cap is 20 (page_size=24 -> 400, GT run 2026-07-18); license/creator/foreign_landing_url per record

sources.name: arena
sources.robots_note: v2 /search/channels works unauthenticated; /search/blocks returns 403 without auth (probe-spike 2026-07-18) — do not use blocks search; block license rarely present, default = link only

sources.name: httpster
sources.robots_note: no robots.txt (404, probe-spike 2026-07-18); hand-picked showcase grid; real nav paths are /style/<name>/ SINGULAR (GT run 2026-07-18: /styles/* -> 404), no search — keyword->path routing, homepage fallback

sources.name: minimal-gallery
sources.robots_note: WordPress; robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/ (probe-spike 2026-07-18); ?s= search returns a page with ZERO result cards (GT run 2026-07-18) — use the /websites/ listing instead, no query targeting

sources.name: land-book
sources.robots_note: robots.txt disallows /api/ and ALL query-param URLs incl. ?search= — homepage/category paths only
sources.known_issue: anti-bot: plain fetch gets 403 (probe-spike 2026-07-18) — expected typed status unavailable:http-403; revisit via Playwright only after owner decision

sources.name: godly
sources.disabled_reason: robots.txt: ClaudeBot/GPTBot/CCBot etc. Disallow: / and content-signal ai-train=no (probe-spike 2026-07-18). Respected by default; enabling is an OWNER decision (use=reference signal permits reference links, but the AI-crawler ban is explicit).
sources.robots_note: User-agent:* allowed; AI crawlers banned; content signal: search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference

sources.name: siteinspire
sources.disabled_reason: robots.txt: ClaudeBot and Claude-SearchBot Disallow: / ; /api/, /collections, category listings disallowed for everyone (probe-spike 2026-07-18). Respected by default; enabling is an OWNER decision.
sources.robots_note: sitemaps exist (websites/profiles/categories) but AI-crawler ban is explicit

sources.name: unsplash
sources.robots_note: key required (demo 50 req/h); ToS REQUIRES hotlinking returned URLs + attribution — hence api-hotlink, no downloads (probe-spike 2026-07-18)

sources.name: pexels
sources.robots_note: key required (200 req/h); Pexels License free use, attribution: link to Pexels + photographer (probe-spike 2026-07-18)
